pastime.en: Reading has always been my favourite pastime, especially on rainy days.
pastime.zh: 阅读一直是我最喜欢的消遣,尤其是下雨天。

leisure.en: I don't have much leisure time at the moment because of my job.
leisure.zh: 由于工作的原因,我目前没有多少闲暇时间。

spare-time.en: In my spare time, I like to go swimming or read a good book.
spare-time.zh: 空闲时间我喜欢游泳或读一本好书。

recreation.en: For recreation, I usually go cycling along the river at weekends.
recreation.zh: 周末休闲时,我通常沿着河边骑车。

entertainment.en: There isn't much entertainment in my village, apart from one small cinema.
entertainment.zh: 我们村没什么娱乐,只有一家小电影院。

amusement.en: The children watched the old man's card tricks with great amusement.
amusement.zh: 孩子们津津有味地看着老人变纸牌戏法。

amusement-park.en: We went to an amusement park for my son's tenth birthday.
amusement-park.zh: 我们去游乐园庆祝儿子十岁生日。

theme-park.en: I went on every ride at the theme park, even the scary ones.
theme-park.zh: 我在主题公园玩了每一个项目,连吓人的都玩了。

outdoor-activities.en: I prefer outdoor activities like hiking to going to the gym.
outdoor-activities.zh: 比起去健身房,我更喜欢徒步这样的户外活动。

indoor.en: When it rains, I usually go to an indoor swimming pool near my flat.
indoor.zh: 下雨时,我通常去公寓附近的室内游泳池。

jogging.en: I go jogging in the park near my home three times a week.
jogging.zh: 我每周三次去家附近的公园慢跑。

workout.en: I do a short workout at home before I start work each morning.
workout.zh: 每天早上开始工作前,我都在家做一次短时间的锻炼。

mountaineering.en: Mountaineering is too dangerous for me, but I enjoy walking in the hills.
mountaineering.zh: 登山对我来说太危险了,但我喜欢在山丘上散步。

camping.en: My family used to go camping by the lake every summer.
camping.zh: 我家以前每年夏天都去湖边露营。

gaming.en: I spent far too much time gaming when I was at university.
gaming.zh: 我上大学时花了太多时间玩电子游戏。

novel.en: The last novel I read was about a family living on a small island.
novel.zh: 我最近读的一本小说讲的是住在小岛上的一家人。

biography.en: I've just finished a biography of a famous Chinese scientist.
biography.zh: 我刚读完一本关于一位著名中国科学家的传记。

autobiography.en: I really enjoyed the singer's autobiography, as it was so honest.
autobiography.zh: 我很喜欢这位歌手的自传,因为写得很坦诚。

genre.en: My favourite film genre is comedy, because it always cheers me up.
genre.zh: 我最喜欢的电影类型是喜剧,因为它总能让我开心起来。

plot.en: The plot of the film was so confusing that I got lost halfway through.
plot.zh: 这部电影的情节太混乱了,我看到一半就看不懂了。

character.en: My favourite character in the series is a funny old doctor.
character.zh: 这部剧里我最喜欢的角色是一位风趣的老医生。

protagonist.en: The protagonist of the book is a young girl who runs away from home.
protagonist.zh: 这本书的主人公是一个离家出走的小女孩。

series.en: I watched the whole series in just one weekend.
series.zh: 我只用一个周末就看完了整部剧。

episode.en: I watch one episode of my favourite show every night before bed.
episode.zh: 我每晚睡前看一集最喜欢的节目。

sitcom.en: I love watching an old American sitcom when I need a laugh.
sitcom.zh: 想笑的时候,我喜欢看一部老的美国情景喜剧。

soap-opera.en: My mum watches the same soap opera every evening after dinner.
soap-opera.zh: 我妈妈每天晚饭后都看同一部肥皂剧。

reality-show.en: I think that most reality shows on television are a bit silly.
reality-show.zh: 我觉得电视上的大多数真人秀都有点傻。

thriller.en: I love a good thriller, especially one with a surprise ending.
thriller.zh: 我喜欢好看的惊悚片,特别是结局出人意料的那种。

comedy.en: I prefer comedy to serious films, because I like to relax after work.
comedy.zh: 比起严肃的电影,我更喜欢喜剧,因为下班后想放松。

animation.en: Japanese animation is really popular among young people in my country.
animation.zh: 日本动画在我国的年轻人中很受欢迎。

science-fiction.en: I've loved science fiction ever since I saw my first space film.
science-fiction.zh: 自从看了第一部太空电影,我就爱上了科幻。

soundtrack.en: The soundtrack of that film is my favourite music to study to.
soundtrack.zh: 那部电影的原声音乐是我学习时最喜欢听的。

lyrics.en: I can never remember the lyrics, so I just sing along badly.
lyrics.zh: 我总记不住歌词,所以只能胡乱跟着唱。

melody.en: That song has such a simple melody that I can't get it out of my head.
melody.zh: 那首歌的旋律很简单,我总忘不掉。

rhythm.en: I have no sense of rhythm, so I'm a terrible dancer.
rhythm.zh: 我没有节奏感,所以跳舞很差劲。

instrument.en: I've always wanted to learn a musical instrument, maybe the guitar.
instrument.zh: 我一直想学一门乐器,也许是吉他。

classical-music.en: I listen to classical music when I need to concentrate on my work.
classical-music.zh: 需要集中精力工作时,我会听古典音乐。

pop-music.en: I mostly listened to pop music when I was a teenager.
pop-music.zh: 我十几岁时主要听流行音乐。

live-music.en: There's a little bar near my flat that has live music on Fridays.
live-music.zh: 我公寓附近有一家小酒吧,周五有现场音乐。

baking.en: I got into baking during the holidays, and now I make bread every week.
baking.zh: 我假期时迷上了烘焙,现在每周都做面包。

collecting.en: I've been collecting stamps from different countries since I was a child.
collecting.zh: 我从小就开始收藏各国的邮票。

painting.en: Painting helps me to relax after a long and busy week at work.
painting.zh: 忙碌工作一周后,绘画能帮助我放松。

sketch.en: I usually carry a small notebook so that I can make a quick sketch.
sketch.zh: 我通常带一个小本子,这样可以随手画张素描。

calligraphy.en: My grandfather taught me calligraphy when I was about eight years old.
calligraphy.zh: 我大约八岁时,爷爷教我书法。

knitting.en: My mum finds knitting very relaxing, especially on cold winter evenings.
knitting.zh: 我妈妈觉得编织很放松,尤其是在寒冷的冬夜。

routine.en: My morning routine is simple: I get up, have a coffee and go for a run.
routine.zh: 我的早晨日常很简单:起床、喝咖啡、去跑步。

punctual.en: I try to be punctual, because I hate keeping other people waiting.
punctual.zh: 我尽量守时,因为我讨厌让别人等。

procrastinate.en: I tend to procrastinate when I have a big piece of work to do.
procrastinate.zh: 有一大堆工作要做时,我往往会拖延。

time-management.en: I'm not great at time management, so I often work late at night.
time-management.zh: 我不太擅长时间管理,所以常常工作到深夜。

morning-person.en: I'm definitely a morning person and do my best work before lunch.
morning-person.zh: 我绝对是个早起的人,午饭前工作效率最高。

night-owl.en: I'm a real night owl, and I rarely go to bed before one o'clock.
night-owl.zh: 我是个十足的夜猫子,很少在一点前睡觉。

social-life.en: My social life has improved a lot since I joined the hiking club.
social-life.zh: 加入徒步俱乐部后,我的社交生活丰富了很多。

get-together.en: My family has a big get-together at my parents' house every New Year.
get-together.zh: 每年新年,我们全家都会在父母家大聚会。

catch-up-with.en: I try to catch up with my old school friends at least once a year.
catch-up-with.zh: 我尽量每年至少和老同学叙一次旧。

hang-out.en: My friends and I like to hang out at a small café after class.
hang-out.zh: 我和朋友们喜欢下课后在一家小咖啡馆待着。

unwind.en: I usually unwind after work by listening to music in the bath.
unwind.zh: 下班后我通常一边泡澡一边听音乐来放松。

recharge.en: I need a quiet weekend at home now and then to recharge.
recharge.zh: 我偶尔需要在家安静地过个周末,恢复精力。

chess.en: My grandfather taught me to play chess when I was six.
chess.zh: 我六岁时,爷爷教我下国际象棋。

billiards.en: My friends and I sometimes play billiards at a small club near the station.
billiards.zh: 我和朋友有时在车站附近的小俱乐部打台球。

bowling.en: We went bowling for my friend's birthday, and I was terrible at it.
bowling.zh: 我们为朋友庆生去打保龄球,我打得很差。

breaststroke.en: I can only swim breaststroke, but I'd really like to learn something faster.
breaststroke.zh: 我只会蛙泳,但很想学点游得更快的泳姿。

freestyle.en: I learned freestyle last year, and now I swim twice a week.
freestyle.zh: 我去年学了自由泳,现在每周游两次。

karaoke.en: We often go to karaoke after work, even though none of us can sing.
karaoke.zh: 我们下班后常去唱卡拉OK,虽然谁都不会唱。

window-shopping.en: On rainy days, my friends and I often go window-shopping at the mall.
window-shopping.zh: 下雨天,我和朋友经常去商场逛街看橱窗。

snapshot.en: I keep an old snapshot of my family on the wall above my desk.
snapshot.zh: 我书桌上方的墙上挂着一张家人的旧快照。

tripod.en: I carry a small tripod when I take photos of the night sky.
tripod.zh: 拍夜空时,我会带一个小三脚架。

foreground.en: I like photos with something interesting in the foreground, such as flowers.
foreground.zh: 我喜欢前景有趣的照片,比如前景是花朵。

album.en: My parents still keep an old photo album from their wedding.
album.zh: 我父母还保留着一本他们婚礼的旧相册。

waltz.en: My parents learned to waltz before their wedding, and they still dance sometimes.
waltz.zh: 我父母婚前学了华尔兹,现在有时还会跳。

tango.en: My friend and I took a tango class, but we were both terrible.
tango.zh: 我和朋友上过一节探戈课,但我们俩都跳得很差。

jazz.en: I started listening to jazz when I went to a small club in New York.
jazz.zh: 我去纽约一家小俱乐部后开始听爵士乐。

puzzle.en: I do a crossword puzzle in the newspaper every morning on the train.
puzzle.zh: 我每天早上在火车上做报纸上的填字谜题。

puzzle.en: It puzzles me why people spend so much money on designer clothes.
puzzle.zh: 我不明白人们为什么花这么多钱买名牌衣服。

socialise.en: I like to socialise with my colleagues after work on Fridays.
socialise.zh: 我喜欢周五下班后和同事们交往聚会。

comic.en: I used to read comic books under the blanket when I was a kid.
comic.zh: 我小时候常躲在被子里看漫画书。

trick.en: My uncle taught me a card trick that I still use at parties.
trick.zh: 我叔叔教了我一个纸牌戏法,我现在还在派对上用。
